q1.question: What does the video creation process include?
q1.answer: Our platform provides a complete end-to-end solution: AI-powered script generation, professional voice synthesis with 200+ voices, and automated video production with matching visuals. You can use all three together or each component independently.

q2.question: How long does it take to create a video?
q2.answer: A typical 2-3 minute video can be created in under 10 minutes. The AI handles scriptwriting, voice generation, and video assembly automatically, dramatically reducing production time compared to traditional methods.

q3.question: Can I customize the AI-generated content?
q3.answer: Absolutely. You have full control at every step—edit scripts, choose voices, adjust pacing and tone, customize visuals, and add your branding. The AI accelerates the process while you maintain creative control.

q4.question: What types of videos can I create?
q4.answer: Marketing videos, product demos, training content, social media posts, explainer videos, corporate communications, and more. Our AI adapts to your needs and style requirements.
